cohort: The study included 17,500 postpartum women who underwent routine blood tests during second and third trimester visits as well as postpartum reviews.
finding: Maternal lymphocyte count was associated with decreased odds of PPD symptoms, while NLR, PLR, and SII during the postpartum period were associated with increased odds of PPD symptoms.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery could modify the association between NLR and PPD symptoms, with the significant association observed only in women without cesarean delivery.
